spans.s: --one of the १४ gan2as of apsaras born of the sun's rays. Br.
III. 7
--a god of the Lekha group. Br. II. ३६. ७६.
(I)--a son of Candra, (Indu) and father of श्राव. भा.
IX. 6

(II)--a righteous king and a son of (Pra) सेनाजित्: Issueless though he had a hundred wives of whom गौरी was one; went to the forest, where he got up the Aindra इष्टि, a sacrifice in honour of Indra. One night he felt thirsty and drank the consecrated water from the sacri- ficial pot. In due time a son was born splitting open the right side of his stomach. He lived for some time and went to Heaven. This son was the great मान्धात (s.v.). भा.
IX. 6
IV. 2
(III)--An Angirasa and मन्त्रकृत्. By his curse half the Ganges came out. Br. II. ३२. १०८; III. ६६. २९; वा. ५९. ९९. [page३-035+ २८]
(IV)--a son of Andhra. Br. III. ६३. २७; वा. ८८. २६.
(V)--the son of अम्बरीष, wife नर्मदा, and son सम्भूत (Harita-वा। प्। and वि। प्।). Br. III. ६३. ७३; वा. ८८. ७३; Vi.
(VI)--during his यज्ञ, there were differen- ces as to the division of पशु। ब्रह्मा interfered and appeased while शक्ति got angry. Br.
IV. 6
(VII)--a son of रणाश्व and father of मन्धात; a मन्त्रकृत्. M. १२. ३४; १४५. १०२.
(VIII)--a son of शूलि of the २४थ् dva1para. वा. २३. २०७.
